notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
[h1]Release date[/h1]
We have to push the release date to 2026. There is simply too much we want to add to the game, and we don't want to risk rushing it. There has been a lot of interest in the game (thank you!) so we want to make sure it's a good one.

[h1]Demo update[/h1]
In a few weeks, we will release a huge update to the demo! Look forward to:
[list]
[*] Exploring the [b]Catacombs[/b], a brand new dungeon with a new final boss.
[*] Venturing into [b]trap doors[/b] in search for treasure.
[*] Lots of new items, Oaths, units, and enemies!
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix run end stat screen display of Apocalypse / Glitch threat levels
[*] Attempt fix for broken item rolls (e.g. incorrect tier, or invalid item)
[/list]

notes.title: Thorns and resource tracking hotfix
notes.content:
This is a minor update to:
[list]
[*] Fix Jagged Carapace (it was scaling based on the enemy armor value)
[*] Fix resource tracking on the run end stat screen
[/list]

notes.title: Attack type oaths
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Run end stats screen
[*] Oaths for attack types (Melee/Ranged/AoE)
[*] Added new player attack (multiple fireballs instead of Burn)
[*] Units are tinted when affected by certain stacks (e.g. Burn and Invincible)
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Capped Burn stacks at 10 (instead of 20)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thorned armor (it was doing something, but not what it was supposed to)
[*] Prevent incorrectly timed tutorial beats on run restart
[/list]

[h2]Misc:[/h2]
[list]
[*] (Windows only) Changed backend graphics from OpenGL to OpenGL ES via ANGLE
[*] Updated Steam SDK
[/list]

notes.title: Updates (v0.38)
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added mouse controls to squad info screen
[*] Added new monster (currently only seen in Gong challenge)
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed tags for Bulwark (added Vanguard) and Archer (removed Vanguard, added Rogue)
[*] Changed starting unit squad (removed one Archer, added one Bulwark)
[*] Reduced Mortar Slime AoE range
[*] Reduced slime enemy armor and slightly increased threat cost (i.e. fewer enemies)
[*] Added additional player character attack bolts
[*] Added starting discount to Vanguard units
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reset input bindings for savefiles created before "Squad Info" screen was added. You may need to re-map your bindings!
[*] Fixed Rampage (incorrectly dealt too much damage to friendly units)
[*] Attempted fix for exceeding stack caps
[*] Added closing shortcuts (pause and back) to squad info screen
[*] Tweaked timer between the two minimap tutorial beats
[*] Removed white dot on unit portraits (mainly visible on Bone Rat)
[/list]

notes.title: Updates (v0.36)
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added detailed squad inspection screen
[*] Bone Rat unit
[*] Added new items (Counter Attack, Shadow Veil, Spectacles)
[*] Stack data (max number and decay time) are now displayed in "More info"
[*] Option added to disable tutorial
[*] Changed default "more info" from "hold" to "toggle"
[*] Now display dungeon floor in recruitment screen
[*] Boss should now have recruitment shrine and vendor
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed Incisive and Cloaked
[*] Increased max cap for Incisive and Cloaked
[*] Changed Rampage balance
[*] Added recruitment shrine to boss fight
[*] Luck rebalanced (lower impact on item tier)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed how respawn rate multiplier works (it's now just reflected in the total time, rather than impacting the timer speed)
[*] Modified respawn sound
[*] Do not store malformed window sizes
[*] Input rebinding sometimes incorrectly captured multiple keys of the same type
[*] "Grit" was not doing anything
[*] Limited the number of squad units that are displayed in the respawn queue, so that they do not overlap the minimap
[*] Hide "more info" prompt when leaving recruitment screen
[/list]

[h2]Misc:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new gamepad mapping (8BitDo Pro 2 for MacOS)
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty settings
notes.content:
New features:
[list]
[*] Added "Threat timer" setting (ability to change how long it takes for the hourglass to turn)
[*] Added difficulty setting (affects starting stats for enemies)
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Increased AoE cap to 7
[*] Boss clears bad stacks when moving
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed input rebinding not being saved
[*] Changes to stored window size management, attempting to prevent crashes and strange window position offsets
[/list]

Misc:
[list]
[*] Added a new gamepad mapping
[*] Implemented updated Steam SDK
[*] Upgrade Defold to 1.10.3
[/list]

notes.title: Explorer Mode
notes.content:
[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Explorer Mode" (available in Gameplay settings) - this removes the hourglass threat feature, instead each floor has a pre-determined threat level
[*] Added settings for FPS cap, Vsync, resetting tutorial, and reverting to default settings
[*] Made price red in Wraith Vendor when an item is unaffordable
[*] Added custom icon for Wraith Vendor on minimap
[/list]

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tweaked item drop rates (fewer drops as many items are collected)
[*] Tweaked reroll costs (item rerolls ramp up quicker)
[*] Buffed Thorns
[*] Capped AoE damage to affect at most 5 enemy units
[*] Tweaked enemy spawning behaviour to prevent enormous clusters in unexplored areas
[*] Don't reset threat hourglass between floors
[*] Added damage/dodge reduction to Rampage
[*] Reduced damage bonus for Zealot's Fury
[*] Reduced length multiplier for Iron Shroud
[*] Reduced amount for Ethereal Form
[*] Reduce damage bonus for Ash Husk
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Attempted fix for softlocking on squad recruitment screen
[*] Fixed bug associated with Bone Golem bone nova
[*] Made back button work in most menus
[*] Changed how volume settings work to make the sliders more intuitive
[*] Fixed bug which caused unit positions to be modified on hit
[/list]

[h3]Sounds:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player taking damage
[*] Sound when an item drops due to Luck stat
[*] Flag bearer inspiration
[*] "To me!" bark and looping effect
[*] Updated pipe and mushroom destructible sound effects
[*] Ballista shot sounds
[*] Bone Golem hurt sounds
[*] Ability not ready sound
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
[p]First of all - thank you to everyone who played our demo! We are so happy with the positive reception so far. We are hard at work on the game, and first out is a patch to address some issues we've discovered in the demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Change log [/h3][list][*][p] In Squad Upgrade when upgrading Recruitment Rank, empty purchase slots are now filled for free[/p][/*][*][p] Rebalance item economy: Drop rates reduce over time, but shop prices scale slower[/p][/*][*][p] Update keyboard key names to be more legible (e.g. ALT and R-ALT instead of LALT and RALT)[/p][/*][*][p] Increase project resources to prevent crashes and text failing to render[/p][/*][*][p] Reset dungeon data in between floors to prevent memory leak[/p][/*][*][p] Prevent player going out of bounds (previously caused by being overcrowded by enemies)[/p][/*][*][p] Added dedicated reroll shortcut button (default R on keyboard)[/p][/*][*][p] Input rebinding "hold to reset" bar should now start empty[/p][/*][*][p] Hide enemy health bars when there are too many enemies[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed double click exploit when accepting challenges[/p][/*][*][p] Changed reroll costs for items (gift and shop), higher cap[/p][/*][*][p] Prevent enemies going out of bounds[/p][/*][*][p] Added ducat/corpuscle cap (999)[/p][/*][*][p] Various minor balance tweaks (including changes to Rampage, Archer, Petard)[/p][/*][*][p] Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements
[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues, either use the in-game bug reporting functionality, post in our dedicated [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3199360/discussions/0/595150606159610977/"]bug reports thread[/url] or post in our [url="https://"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Blending Vampire Survivors and Diablo, Skull Horde has a brand new demo
notes.content:
Practically a modern classic, Vampire Survivors has inspired countless imitators. But the upcoming Skull Horde actually looks like a novel take on its roguelike inspiration. While in Vampire Survivors you gain new abilities to upgrade your avatar, in Skull Horde you'll build a massive army of fellow skeletons and lead them to victory through a dank dungeon. The game has an earnest and goofy tone, like a Tales from the Crypt episode that hits just right. You can give the game a try right now.

Read the rest of the story...
